rationale: The target is a complete and source-faithful formalization of Remark 2.7.9 and its explicit cross-references. Its probability-space binders, boundedness and normalization hypotheses, standard-normal identity, global-versus-local MGF domains, absolute-factor property conversions, and uncentered Exp(1) boundary case all match the source. The target's only consequential difference is beneficial: it replaces the source's undefined approximation notation by exact little-o statements. Because those exact asymptotic claims imply the heuristic source text but are not logically entailed by that informal text alone, the fixed classification is faithful-stronger.
